column1: # Translations of the trade-routes plugin's own texts (key = its own id for the text

column2: Trade routes: a team of heroes and their columns opens up routes of linked nodes, on a budget of stamina

perHour: stamina an hour of budget gives; edge: a path; clearedShare: of it once both ends are cleared; battle: a fight; supplyFirst / supplyPass: a supply point won / passed; maxHeroes: a team; capLevel / capOther: a hero's men (level x capLevel + each attribute x capOther, or its own factor in capAttrs); aimHalf: the aim points (aimAttrs) at which a hero (or an enemy general) strikes the enemy it counters half the time.
column3: 商路规则：每小时预算给的体力、走一段路的体力、两端都打通后按这个比例、每场战斗的体力、打下修整点 / 路过修整点得到的体力、每队最多几名英雄、英雄带兵上限（等级 × 等级系数 + 各属性 × 各自的系数，没写的属性按其余系数）、识破的半数点（英雄或敌将的识破点数到这个数时，一半的机会先砍被自己克制的一路）。

column2: How each attribute counts towards a hero's men on a trade route, e.g. {"leadership": 10} (others: capOther).
column3: 商路带兵上限里各属性的系数，例如统率 10（没写的属性按"其余系数"）。

column2: Hours of budget to choose from, e.g. [1, 8, 24, 72].
column3: 可选的预算小时数，例如 1、8、24、72。
